Daily nitrate concentrations at NEON river sites (June–July 2019)

Source: R/data-doc.R
nitrates_small.Rd

A dataset containing daily mean nitrate concentrations for three NEON freshwater sites, used for the nitrateApp Shiny app.

Usage

nitrates_small

Format

A tibble with 183 rows and 3 variables:

site

NEON site code (ARIK, CARI, LEWI)

date

Date of observation (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC)

nitrate_mgL

Daily mean nitrate concentration (milligrams per litre, mg/L)

Source

National Ecological Observatory Network (NEON), product DP1.20033.001.

Examples

data("nitrates_small", package = "nitrateApp")
head(nitrates_small)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   site  date       nitrate_mgL
#>   <chr> <date>           <dbl>
#> 1 ARIK  2019-06-01        5.30
#> 2 ARIK  2019-06-02        5.2 
#> 3 ARIK  2019-06-03        5.15
#> 4 ARIK  2019-06-04        5.32
#> 5 ARIK  2019-06-05        5.13
#> 6 ARIK  2019-06-06        5.07
